title: 8th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/8/1/2026).

Question time: North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim asks the Minister of Construction, Housing and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib, how far the Giraavarufalhu land reclamation has progressed, when the new land use plan will be completed and plot numbers and registries handed to the people, and whether the government intends to relocate the Giraavarufalhu plots elsewhere.

Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim, to gauge the view of members on actions the government is taking contrary to the Constitution, relevant laws and the 2026 state budget passed by the Majlis.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the National Service Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by South Kulhudhuffushi MP Faruhath Mohamed.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the Bill to amend the Land Transport Act (Law No. 5/2009), submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's submission for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to the Argentine Republic.
Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's submission for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to question the Housing Minister on Giraavarufalhu reclamation, debate an opposition resolution against the government, continue the National Service and Land Transport bills, and take up two ambassador reports.
